velocity_mean_mps.meaning: predicted forward speed for this window

velocity_log_variance.meaning: natural-log of predicted variance; consumer computes variance = exp(this) and MUST NOT treat this value as variance or std directly

compatibility_rule: The Android app declares MIN_SUPPORTED_CONTRACT_VERSION. If a downloaded model's contract_version (read from this manifest, or from the ONNX metadata_props embedded in the file itself) is not semver-compatible, the app MUST refuse to load it and fall back per FR-24 (model-failure fallback), never attempt to run it anyway.
